name: @evavo/art-studio
description: Governed art production system for game, digital and print assets.

scripts.dev:worker: pnpm run build:domain && pnpm --filter @evavo/art-studio-worker start -- daemon
scripts.worker:once: pnpm run build:domain && pnpm --filter @evavo/art-studio-worker start -- once
scripts.worker:until-idle: pnpm run build:domain && pnpm --filter @evavo/art-studio-worker start -- until-idle
scripts.build:domain: pnpm --filter @evavo/art-contracts build && pnpm --filter @evavo/art-direction build && pnpm --filter @evavo/art-sprite-planner build && pnpm --filter @evavo/art-sprite-supervisor build && pnpm --filter @evavo/art-core build && pnpm --filter @evavo/art-repo-inspector build && pnpm --filter @evavo/art-quality build && pnpm --filter @evavo/art-media build && pnpm --filter @evavo/art-provider-canvas build && pnpm --filter @evavo/art-godot build && pnpm --filter @evavo/art-artifacts build && pnpm --filter @evavo/art-providers build && pnpm --filter @evavo/art-selection build && pnpm --filter @evavo/art-sprite-family build && pnpm --filter @evavo/art-repair build && pnpm --filter @evavo/art-runtime build
scripts.check: pnpm run toolchain:check:installed && pnpm run toolchain:test && pnpm run build:domain && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
